metadata.source: Survey of India (per src_agency attribute in the source data)
metadata.hosted_via: National Water Data Portal (NWDP), NWIC, Ministry of Jal Shakti -- https://nwdp.nwic.gov.in/dataset/village-boundary (the portal's own breadcrumb tags 'Geological Survey of India' as the uploading Data Producer; every source feature's own src_agency attribute reads 'Survey of India (SOI)')
metadata.processing: reprojected to EPSG:4326, geometry simplified with Douglas-Peucker (tolerance 0.0005 deg, ~55m, preserve_topology=True), coordinates rounded to 5 decimal places (~1m), attributes trimmed from 73 source columns to 11
metadata.quality: verified-official -- Survey of India source, see docs/DATA_SOURCES.md
metadata.known_quirks: 0 feature(s) carry vlcode=999999, a sentinel the source uses for incomplete/placeholder records rather than a real LGD id -- the accompanying village name is sometimes a real place (e.g. a reserve-forest area) and sometimes the source's own literal placeholder text 'Data Partially Available' -- left as-is, not corrected either way. 0 feature(s) have self-intersecting source geometry -- left as-is, not repaired (of these, 0 could not be Douglas-Peucker simplified because GEOS raised a topology error on the raw shape; a buffer(0) self-intersection fix was tried first, and only where that also failed is the original unsimplified geometry kept verbatim). Neither is fabricated or silently dropped.
